title: Accelerated Nehari manifold optimization methods for computing ground state solutions of coupled elliptic systems
summary: This paper presents a class of efficient algorithms for computing the ground state solutions of a semilinear elliptic system, which are unstable saddle points of the variational functional. Variational arguments show that these unstable saddle points can be characterized as the local minimizers of the variational functional constrained to the Nehari manifold $\mathcal{N}$. The Nehari manifold optimization method (NMOM) proposed in [Z. Chen, W. Liu, Z. Xie, and W. Yi. {\em SIAM J. Sci.
